Speaker: The Coach
Text: Tutorial base. Same buildings, same matches, its own save - so break whatever you like in here.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Three things and you know the game. A team is nine regulars and three Stars. A match is a run of little duels. An Adventure is a run out for materials.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Which one do you want first?

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Every tier holds one card of each power. Tier I has a 0, a 1 and a 2. Tier II has a 1, a 2 and a 3. And so on up.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Which means nobody fields three fives. Not you, not them. It is the one rule the whole game leans on.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: The numbers live in TierPowers.csv. Change them there and every screen in the game changes with them - the builder, the pitch, the enemy side.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: A match is rounds. Each round you are offered cards from one tier, you pick one, they pick one, and the better number that round takes it.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Press Escape in a match for the sub menu - speed, AUTO, and the way out. AUTO plays it for you, which is how you watch a balance change rather than click through one.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Go on then. The Training Pitch is the middle building.
